source.checkpoint_lineage: same-seed SW0097 seed1 strict-mapped through SW0135 native32; preserve encoder, graph, membrane, dendrite, Kuramoto and gate source initialization
source.prior_exposure_scope: source is already a 70,000-image, 16x16-grid trained model; SW0142 does not claim fresh native32 representation pretraining
source.native32_parity_lineage: reuse the frozen SW0135 native32 zero-adapter parity evidence and bind its implementation dependencies; SW0142 does not alter those helpers

input.mask: 16 of 64 row-major 16x16 pixel tiles selected by SHA256-keyed RandomState from image_id and exposure; masked pixels set to 128

rollout.readout: all 512 settled native actual component spikes [B,4,1024,512]

readout: SW0135 exchangeable native spike slot binder and shared relative-coordinate RGB decoder; P is sole slot mixture and sole primary mask source
objective: per-image (MSE_masked + 0.25*MSE_visible) / max(mean channel spatial variance of unmasked target, 1e-6), then logical-batch mean; no Q/PLV/C/teacher/GT objective

cache.warm_state: persist binder, decoder, optimizer moments, history and hashes

paired_pilot.mask_exposure: update index + 1, shared by both arms
paired_pilot.head_optimizer_moments: shared warm state restored independently into each arm
paired_pilot.projection: a_d and a_m clamped to [0,1] after optimizer step
paired_pilot.registered_train_diagnostics: first 64 registered TRAIN rows: report base reconstruction, P-row permutation, and within-coarse-RGB-bin P permutation; geometry is recomputed while slot latents are held fixed. Diagnostics are descriptive, not eligibility guards.

evaluation.primary: native32 P argmax; largest hard slot is background, deterministic canonical labels
evaluation.secondary: unchanged SW0136 QCC, positive-clamped product affinity threshold .50, min8, largest-component background
evaluation.gt: native128 labels reduced to 32x32 by registered 4x4 modal/min-ID contract only after all predictions and hashes are frozen

promotion.primary_foreground_ari: core_trainable must exceed encoder_graph and source97 by at least 0.01; paired image-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 against both
promotion.foreground_iou: at least registered three-seed Slot mean +0.05
promotion.object_iou: at least registered three-seed Slot mean +0.05

bootstrap.method: paired image resampling with common indices

promotion.failure: close this recipe; no mask/LR/slot/window sweeps or automatic seed expansion

limitations: One-seed stage-1 evidence is not a three-seed result.
A successful RGB reconstruction or nonzero gradient does not establish object segmentation or gate necessity.
No GT is used for training, caching, warmup, or prediction.
No reserve images or data-scaling claim.
